retrievalProfile.description: A warm, wood-textured layout featuring a central acoustic guitar silhouette overlaid with intricate mandalas and geometric circular patterns.

recipe.visualDefinition: A vertical composition centered on a stylized acoustic guitar body rendered in warm wood tones. The image is layered with delicate, gold-toned ornamental mandalas and intersecting thin-line circles that create a sense of rhythmic vibration. A dark header bar contains secondary text, while the primary title is positioned in the lower third with a metallic, beveled finish.
coreVisualRelationships: Central guitar silhouette as the primary structural frame
Intricate mandalas centered on the soundhole and corners
Intersecting circles suggesting sound waves and geometry
Dark top banner contrasting with the warm wood body
Beveled display typography anchored in the lower third
coreInvariants: Vertical wood grain texture throughout the background
Warm palette of amber, sienna, and deep red

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The guitar body is centered and fills approximately 80% of the frame vertically.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central soundhole mandala acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the dark top banner down the guitar neck to the central mandala, then out to the large title text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with texture and ornamental patterns.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm wood tones (amber, burnt orange, sienna)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black header bar and dark brown wood grain
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Gold for ornamental patterns and light blue for subtitle text
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the warm spectrum with deep shadows in the wood grain for texture.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid cool blues or greens except as minor accents

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Sturdy, high-contrast serif and clean sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Primary title uses a heavy serif with sharp, triangular serifs
Secondary text uses a wide-tracked, geometric sans-serif
Subtitle uses a condensed, blocky sans-serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'R' in the main title features a distinctive curved leg
The 'W' is constructed from two overlapping 'V' shapes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for the main title paired with a wide-tracked sans-serif for a modern-vintage balance.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the sturdy, small-serif feel of the main title
Matches the geometric, wide-tracked header text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a vertical wood grain texture in warm amber and sienna. Overlay a centered silhouette of an acoustic guitar body. Add intricate gold mandala patterns on the soundhole and corners, and thin-line intersecting circles across the center. Include a solid black bar at the very top.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in the lower third using a bold, beveled serif font with a gold gradient. Add the secondary title in the top black bar using a wide-tracked, light blue sans-serif font.

verificationChecks: Is the wood grain texture visible and warm-toned?
Are the mandala and circle overlays present?
Is the main title beveled and metallic?
Is the header text widely tracked?

postGenerationChecks: Confirm wide tracking in the header
Check color harmony between gold and wood
recipe.reuseFormula: Acoustic Guitar Silhouette + Wood Grain Texture + Mandala Overlays + Beveled Serif Typography = Folk Anthology Aesthetic
